column2: AN ACT TO AMEND THE WILLS ORDINANCE (CHAPTER 60)
BE it enacted by the Parliament of the Democratic Socialist
Republic of Sri Lanka as follows: -
1. This Act may be cited as the Wills (Amendment) Act,
No.      of 2022.
2. Section  2  of  the  Wills  Ordinance  (Chapter  60)
(hereinafter referred to as the “principal enactment”) is hereby
repealed and the following section is substituted therefor:–
